releases.name: Freeze report fix
releases.summary: Stops false freeze reports while a message waits for a click.
notes: When a message such as tournament commentary waited for a click, 0.1.29 could wrongly write a freeze report after 30 seconds. The report now watches whether the screen is still updating, so only real freezes are recorded.
Retains all 0.1.29 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults.

releases.name: Freeze reports
releases.summary: Records where the game is stuck when it stops responding.
notes: When the picture freezes for 20 to 30 seconds while the game is still running, the game now writes golf.log.freeze.txt next to golf.log with exactly where it is stuck, so a freeze can be reported and fixed. The game keeps running. [fixes] freeze_report=0 turns it off.
Retains all 0.1.28 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults. Controlled stall tests pass; the reported championship freeze itself is not yet diagnosed.

releases.name: Safer artwork, input and audio handling
releases.summary: Safer artwork, input and audio handling.
notes: Fixes path-overlay storage when switching between rectangular course sizes and safely retries failed allocations.
Makes HD art and menu/report artwork publication transactional, preserving the last complete image until a retry succeeds; fixes a D3D11 reference leak during renderer recovery.
Cancels stuck camera dragging when a modal report opens or a UI layer consumes the real mouse release.
Keeps music and sound-effect volume categories separate from voice limits and WAV size, including credits music and ambience.
Clarifies manual Path view controls and the automatic placement overlay. Automatic placement visibility is unchanged.
Restores full-screen page precedence over Options course retention while preserving the complete course behind ordinary Options.
Retains existing saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults. Controlled tests pass; affected-player and physical device-loss acceptance remain pending.

releases.name: Restores speed when zoomed out on large courses
releases.summary: Restores speed when zoomed out on large courses.
notes: Fixes a slowdown when zoomed out on large, busy courses that 0.1.26 introduced. Checking the game's lighting data for every shaded sprite made each frame several times slower; the check is cheap again, and a draw that reads released memory is still skipped without HD art instead of crashing.
Retains all 0.1.26 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults, including the zoom-out crash fix. Controlled zoom tests pass; confirmation on the affected player's PC remains pending.

releases.name: Fixes a crash when zooming out on large courses
releases.summary: Fixes a crash when zooming out on large courses.
notes: Fixes a crash when zooming out on large courses with HD art. The game could read lighting data it had already released; it now checks that memory each time and skips HD art for a draw instead of crashing.
Retains all 0.1.25 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults. A controlled zoom test that crashed 0.1.25 now passes; confirmation on the affected player's PC remains pending.

releases.name: Crash recovery, readable golfer cards, and water that respects raised land
releases.summary: Crash recovery, readable golfer cards, and water that respects raised land.
notes: Fixes the sound-allocation crash identified in the #69 follow-up. Decoded sounds now have a bounded cache, and allocation failures no longer escape into the game.
Golfer-card and menu text retry failed font loading, texture uploads and drawing. Smaller uploads reduce memory pressure, and graphics resets rebuild missing text.
HD water and waterfalls no longer paint across raised landmark foundations and cliffs, which could make landmarks look like they were floating. Original water remains available.
Adds a per-round **Start a story: On/Off** choice when pairing golfers in the Clubhouse. On keeps the original story selection; Off starts the pair without a story.
Repairs negative skill ratings, selected match portraits, shot skill previews, pair compatibility, ranking and Home Site counters, and departure notices in message history.
Improves Options text wrapping, numbered land-tract selection with a separate Buy confirmation, cut-content help, and the indication when weather is disabled.
Fixes the clipped award legend on short-course reports and handles map-render allocation failure safely.
Retains all 0.1.24 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults. Controlled native tests cover the fixes; confirmation on the affected players' PCs remains pending.

releases.name: Faster play on large, busy courses with HD art
releases.summary: Faster play on large, busy courses with HD art.
notes: Fixes the slowdown on large, busy courses with HD art reported in #73. A memory safety check ran for every HD sprite in every frame; it now reuses its result within a frame. On the reported course, game speed returns to normal.
Mod profile names with quotes or other special characters now save and load correctly. A load order file that cannot be read is kept as a backup instead of being replaced.
The game now starts from install folders named in other alphabets, such as Japanese or Cyrillic, on the main Windows drive.
Very large courses handle low memory more safely: ground, water and HD art keep the last complete picture instead of failing.
Ground textures retry a failed graphics upload and keep the working picture meanwhile.
Retains all 0.1.23 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults.

releases.name: Safer Practice Round starts and smoother clubhouse loading
releases.summary: Safer Practice Round starts and smoother clubhouse loading.
notes: Practice Round now safely reports when a playing partner is unavailable. Retry after a group finishes; failed attempts preserve existing golfers and course state.
Prevents the original clubhouse appearing briefly before its replacement finishes loading.

Adds recovery for graphics resets, including rebuilding text, terrain and artwork and cancelling an interrupted zoom effect. This addresses the graphics target path seen in crash reports; confirmation on affected PCs remains pending.
Restores only visible artwork after graphics resets, reducing memory pressure on large courses. Off-screen artwork loads when needed.
Keeps original-water texture updates bounded across resets and preserves switching back to HD water.
Improves crash reports with loaded-module information and protects font and interface asset paths across threads.
Retains all 0.1.22 features, saves, settings, assets and remastered defaults.

releases.name: Repair repeated course welcome messages in notification history
releases.summary: Repair repeated course welcome messages in notification history.
notes: Course welcome messages appear once in message history, including Carolina. Display-timer changes no longer add extra copies; genuine later notices remain available. Fixes #71.

releases.name: Player-report repairs, in-game mod configuration and optional joined bunkers
releases.summary: Player-report repairs, in-game mod configuration and optional joined bunkers.
notes: Professional accomplishments now include remaining goals. Pro profiles show matching skill bars, and live matches include the direct opponent's scorecard.
Golfer cards describe skills as abilities. Clothing colours remain stable during play, and new unedited visitors retain the original multi-skill assignment used for hole qualification.
Staff coverage circles follow their assigned spot, with Staff and Aura coverage on the Routing Map.
New courses reset landmark unlocks. Parkland rock gaps use matching rough, and shot analysis preserves tree lighting.
Added prominent green Configure controls and named settings inside the Mods screen, preserving existing choices and Vanilla behavior.
Optional joined pot bunkers combine adjacent sand with rounded edges and a steep outer rim. Original sand colours are retained; the feature is off by default.
Retains the remastered construction menu default, Living Club, sharp legacy text, path styles, optional course lamps and all previous release features.

releases.name: Restore the remastered construction menu as the default
releases.summary: Restore the remastered construction menu as the default.
notes: Corrected the accidental classic-menu default in 0.1.19. Fresh installs and upgrades open the remastered menu unless the player explicitly selected classic controls.
The original construction wheel and trays remain optional in Options. Explicit menu preferences are preserved.
Retains the sharp legacy text fixes and all previously shipped features.

releases.name: Classic construction controls and sharp legacy interface text
releases.summary: Classic construction controls and sharp legacy interface text.
notes: Restored the classic construction wheel and trays with a live, persisted Options switch to the modern Course palette.
Legacy original and modern fonts render at display resolution on Windows, with clipping, copied text and overlap handling.
Existing optional HD artwork supplies the original construction panels. Original HUD, bitmap text and vanilla remain reachable.

releases.name: New course-building choices, optional lamps, and refined sunlight and reflections
releases.summary: New course-building choices, optional lamps, and refined sunlight and reflections.
notes: Choose from 18 cosmetic path materials in a compact picture picker. Materials survive saving and loading; the original look remains available.
The Course build menu groups the terrain tools together, with Trees, Extras and optional Lights kept accessible.
Added six optional course-light designs with day/night artwork and saved placement. They are off by default.
Refined optional sunlight clarity, water reflections and directional shadows, including stable lighting while paused. Rainbows remain off by default.
Optional click-and-drag placement keeps the original per-tile prices and rules. Individual placement remains the default.
Preserves the 0.1.17 golfer roster, Living Club, clubhouse, save-name, construction, pro-shot and updater fixes.
Keeps original visitor skill progression, mood reactions and weather gameplay effects as the default. Optional appearance and gameplay switches remain independent.
Includes compatibility delivery of lamp assets and data for existing updater versions.

releases.name: A larger cast, optional living-course features and a batch of interface repairs
releases.summary: A larger cast, optional living-course features and a batch of interface repairs.
notes: Added 45 authored golfer identities and portraits, with original ordinary visitor skill progression by default. New arrival skill mixes are optional.
Added switchable Living Club personalities, dialogue, memories and stories. Extra mood reactions are opt-in.
Added optional lighting and regional weather. Effects on ball rolls and arriving golfers are opt-in.
Bundled the approved Parkland clubhouse. New authored terrain is a separate optional Terrain Mod download; original textures and independent art switches remain available.
Fixed clubhouse layer loading, retention while Options is open, and the original falling construction animation.
Fixed pro shot readouts and shot choices in Practice and matches, with original-text controls retained.
Modernised Routing Map, remembered the selected theme and added Space pause under the modern keyboard profile.
Fixed Save-name selection and quiet cancellation. Empty submitted names still produce the original warning.
Fixed duplicate welcome history, welcome wording and truncation of longer welcome messages.
Added real updater byte progress and a visible verification phase while protecting player settings, mods and saves.

Retained staff placement repairs for expanded courses and camera/scrolling fixes. New gameplay additions are independently switchable. Original energy, mood and weed balance remains the default. Manual par editing and drag-to-build are not included. No original game files are bundled.

releases.name: Release 0.1.16
notes: Bundled clubhouse art is delivered through the existing updater while preserving user HD packs.

Added the approved Parkland clubhouse model and garden, with all four views and original-cadence animated flags and birdbath water. Existing HD art stays available; Original textures retain the original building.
Restored the original assigned golfer clothing colours after repairing lost palette-call arguments in the translated game.
Saved courses open over the clubhouse, with tee and map-centre fallbacks when needed, avoiding empty black starting views on expanded courses.

Modern course hints and placement, purchase and removal labels now use the readable native typography. Original text options remain available. Existing loading improvements, HD chooser pictures and landmark benefit descriptions are retained. Original energy, mood and weed balance is unchanged. Original game data is not included. # Changelog

releases.name: Faster startup and course creation, with smooth loading progress
releases.summary: Faster startup and course creation, with smooth loading progress.
notes: Removed avoidable pauses and repeated work while loading game assets.
Reduced new-course loading time by 34 percent in repeated warm 4K tests, from a median 2.0 to 1.3 seconds compared with the preceding fast-loading candidate.
Reused terrain calculations within each rebuild and decoded initial ground images in parallel, preserving course generation, random state and full image quality.
Loading bars now move smoothly between real progress updates without adding a minimum wait.

Original loading paths remain available through the performance switches. Controlled cold-cache timings are not available. Generated maps and simulation state, save/reload and serial-versus-parallel image results were checked. No original game files are included.

releases.name: Original landmark benefits are visible again
releases.summary: Original landmark benefits are visible again.
notes: Fixed: the modern landmark chooser shows the original benefit alongside the name and price, and in hover tips for available and locked designs.

Original prices, unlock requirements and landmark effects are preserved. The previous modern text remains available with fixes.landmark_perks=0. Original energy, mood and weed balance is preserved. Qualification uses focused checks and hidden game runs; the full 91-stage regression remains incomplete at 35/91.

releases.name: Sharper object pictures in the build interface
releases.summary: Sharper object pictures in the build interface.
notes: Fixed: bench, landmark, flower-bed, scenic-tree and scenic-bridge choosers use the existing HD art pack when available.
Fixed: Course > Extras uses complete object pictures for the five design buttons.

Original art and interface choices remain available. Original dark golfer labels are retained by design. Original energy, mood and weed balance is preserved. No new artwork or original game data is bundled.

releases.name: Cleaner reports, Home Site previews and dialogs
releases.summary: Cleaner reports, Home Site previews and dialogs.
notes: Fixed: report tabs keep their modern panel visible while opening the next page.
Fixed: Home Site shows the original lot value, clearing cost, preparation cost and profit in the modern placement card.
Fixed: Hire and Save dialogs suppress old purple panels underneath the modern interface.

Fixed: rapid Your pro/Staff switching and repeated Practice clicks keep old controls out of the modern interface. Original energy, mood and weed balance is preserved. Qualification uses focused checks and hidden game runs. The full 91-stage regression remains incomplete at 35/91. AI/crowding, timing, energy, weeds, art preferences and other unresolved reports remain open. Original-interface behavior remains available.

releases.name: Pro scorecards and steady placement
releases.summary: Pro scorecards and steady placement.
notes: Fixed: Your pro can open the live scorecard while playing, including the current stroke count on the back nine.
Fixed: modern shot choices stay visible and respond when Your pro is reopened while paused; pause stays active.

Fixed: landmarks and scenic bridges remain selected for repeated placement. Set ui.repeat_amenities=0 to restore single placement. Qualification uses focused checks and hidden game runs. The full 91-stage regression remains incomplete at 35/91. AI/crowding, timing, energy, weeds, report transitions and other unresolved reports remain open. Original-interface behavior remains available.

releases.name: Practice screens and shot choices stay clear
releases.summary: Practice screens and shot choices stay clear.
notes: Fixed: Practice no longer draws legacy skill text beneath the modern course interface.
Fixed: the modern pro shot-choice tray stays open through a shot, keeping the next shot's choices available. Escape and explicit dismissal remain available.

Fixed: the active target hole keeps its original blinking highlight with HD artwork, preserving its brightening effect. Qualification uses focused checks and hidden game runs. The full 91-stage regression remains incomplete at 35/91. AI/crowding, timing, energy, weeds and other unresolved reports remain open. Original-interface behavior remains available.

releases.name: Clearer pro and report screens, with safer updates
releases.summary: Clearer pro and report screens, with safer updates.
notes: Changed: Top Ten Designers uses a native panel while preserving the original scores and original-mode board.
Fixed: clubhouse pairing shows each golfer once and keeps selection, Cancel and Start working through the original match logic.
Fixed: the Skills page opened before a Match clears old HUD badges before drawing.
Fixed: Hole Stats transitions keep the native panel and world labels consistent.
Fixed: the updater rejects empty or unreadable staged programs and verifies both installed launcher copies.
Fixed: failed stage cleanup stops preparation; incomplete rollback retains recovery files and does not restart a partially restored game.

Fixed: manual setup preserves existing mod profiles and custom mod files while installing missing defaults. Updating from 0.1.4, 0.1.5 or 0.1.6: download this ZIP and run Setup.cmd manually once, choosing your existing Remastered install folder. If your current game executable is empty, use the same manual install path. The game checks GitHub for update metadata automatically unless update checks are disabled. Download and installation happen only after you choose Update now. Game files and saves are not uploaded. Qualification uses focused checks and hidden game runs. The full 91-stage regression remains incomplete at 35/91. AI/crowding and other open reports remain under investigation. Updater checks do not establish power-loss or hard-kill durability.

releases.name: Updater repairs, clean shadows and clearer original-interface controls
releases.summary: Updater repairs, clean shadows and clearer original-interface controls.
notes: Fixed: the updater can finish applying files and restart the game after the native launcher exits.
Fixed: the dark rectangular patch beneath the practice flag and golfer highlights now follows the original oval shadow mask.
Fixed: the cart-path control stays below the original money, fun and skill bars at different rendering sizes.
Added: a Rotate (Tab) button beside the original building tray. Tab and Escape retain their original actions.
Changed: the end-of-year summary uses a centered Frosted Mint page with a working Continue button.

Added: an optional community-theme importer for the supplied story, pro and celebrity ZIPs. It validates files, protects existing themes and keeps the original content available. Updating from 0.1.5 or 0.1.6: download this ZIP and run Setup.cmd manually once, choosing your existing Remastered install folder. The older in-game updater can exit before it applies an update. Qualification uses focused checks and hidden game runs. The full 91-stage regression remains incomplete. AI/crowding and other open reports remain under investigation.

releases.name: Clearer shot previews and fixes for Options, dialogs and award signs
releases.summary: Clearer shot previews and fixes for Options, dialogs and award signs.
notes: Fixed: HD course textures stay stable while Options is open, through rapid tab changes and when closing it.
Fixed: shot previews reach the native renderer after the original game has calculated their flight points.
Changed: the modern shot buttons keep a clearer white flight path, visible sample points and a small landing marker. The arrow stops at its actual final point.
Fixed: shot availability reads the ball's actual terrain position.
Fixed: award plaques retain their colors and draw a shadow instead of a bright green patch.
Fixed: numeric date hints display a readable calendar date in a compact popup.
Fixed: golfer profile category labels no longer open the saying editor. The saying text remains editable.
Changed: the exit option says Return to Main Menu.

Fixed: archive extraction failures reach clear recovery instructions in Windows PowerShell, including Windows versions without LZMA support. Extract those archives with 7-Zip and select their disc image.

releases.name: Clearer building controls and more reliable rendering and settings
releases.summary: Clearer building controls and more reliable rendering and settings.
notes: Fixed: long water-path bridges, corners and shore joins stay connected in every camera rotation.
Fixed: the first real custom theme folder is discovered, and long theme lists scroll with reachable selection buttons.
Fixed: build-tab and Escape transitions retain the last complete course frame instead of briefly showing a different texture layer.
Fixed: the old golfer-card artwork no longer appears behind its native replacement, including HD textures.
Fixed: resent terrain textures replace their existing cache entry after a successful upload, avoiding duplicate allocations.
Fixed: failed UI texture uploads preserve the previous image and retry; font, text-buffer and PNG allocation failures are handled safely.
Fixed: Windows file listings include courses and files beyond the old 512-entry cutoff.
Fixed: mod profiles, overrides and options preserve the previous file when writing or replacement fails.
Fixed: malformed WAV format chunks and invalid sample rates are rejected; local mix recordings finish their headers on shutdown.
Fixed: save/snapshot routing matches complete directory names. Similar names remain in the game folder.
Fixed: installer image parsing rejects incomplete records and invalid PE headers without changing the existing-folder installation workflow.
Fixed: construction tray retention follows the armed tool; ordinary course clicks and explicit Escape still dismiss controls.
Added: translation refuses mismatched portrait-fix anchors instead of silently dropping those repairs.
Reviewed: all 15 open contributor PRs. Useful changes from #2, #3, #4, #5, #6, #7, #10 and #12 were adapted; existing fixes and unverified developer tools were kept separate.
Changed: cart-path help uses a lighter tint and leaves buildings and the course background unobscured. Building connection warnings remain readable.
Changed: one supported course layout, retaining the selected Corners toolbar and stats. Alternate toolbar and course-screen layout choices are removed from Options.
Fixed: selecting a building no longer draws a second placement/Rotate card over its open tray. Placement help remains available when the tray is closed.
Fixed: rapid zoom changes remain smooth through short rendering delays.
Fixed: message history remains readable and clickable while cart-path help is enabled. Closing history restores the path controls.
Fixed: closely spaced notices are preserved in message history, including repeated accepted notices.
Fixed: pathway and landmark placement outlines stay aligned with the ground after smooth camera movement. The same correction applies to screen-space guide lines.
Fixed: employee work zones support coordinates 128 and above on large maps, while preserving legacy negative targets and existing save bytes.

releases.name: Staff expansion and safer play
releases.summary: Staff expansion and safer play. More setup choices, cleaner controls, and fixes for saves, reports and course details.
notes: Changed: staff starts at the original limit of 20. Options > Gameplay can raise it to 100; existing staff survive lowering the limit and saving/loading
Fixed: a busy save-name box no longer shows the old moving text strip
Fixed: temporary text strings are terminated before font measurements, preventing a verified invalid read
Fixed: failed mod-record writes no longer emit a successful completion receipt
Fixed: Esc closes the active layer in order, build trays stay open after placement, cart shadows align, and uncovered weeds offer an Open staff notice
Fixed: tee-to-cup lines align at both ends, pro profiles distinguish adults and children, and the Best Hole award plaque is readable
New: setup can use an existing SimGolf installation folder as well as a disc image, with checked files and a separate required version 1.02 program
Fixed: tournament camera cleanup restores the original course tiles, including after save/load; Career can place the clubhouse automatically or leave it for manual placement
Fixed: the pro shot readout and pro export use the current game values and chosen save name
Fixed: No thanks on the land-purchase page keeps your money, with the pointer held on the intended exit control
Fixed: additional verified table, animation and shot-cache bounds guards (switch fixes.re_bounds)
Fixed: the browser development build compiles with the default pro skill settings again
Fixed: the first dialogs and reports now use the new interface from their first visible frame
New: a Mod Manager (Mods on the start menu, in Options,): search, sort, filters, load order, profiles, conflict and missing-mod warnings, changes apply on restart
The property map legend says "Can't afford" instead of "Too dear"
New: an Updates panel on the start menu shows what is new and can check for a new version (Update now checks the download before installing; turn the check off in Options)

Fixed: a building being placed hung off to one side of the mouse; the middle of the building now sits under the pointer ([ui] place_center=0 keeps golf's corner placement). Buildings that turn get a Rotate button while placing
New: 16 painted badges for the properties on the map list ([ui] map_badges=original keeps golf's emblems)

Changed: the pro works like the original game again: no pro popup at a career start, Edit pro from People, Practice opens the skill page; Look buttons (skin, hair, shirt, pants) on Create your pro now work, and the old profile and skill screens no longer show behind the new pages

Fixed: Time to Play in the course report climbed every game year (past 5 hours on small courses, so the tournament check failed). Hole 1's start time read only one byte of the game clock. Found and diagnosed by cvanderlinden (issue #2, PR #3). Saves with an inflated hole 1 are repaired when they load, and golfers already on hole 1 have truncated start ticks re-stamped (switch fixes.hole_time)
Fixed: a few sounds that never played because their file names differ a little from the installed files (lake, alligator, marshal and others)
Fixed: three counters in the course map summary were read as one byte, wrong above 127 on big maps
Fixed: updating replaced your own mods.ini; an update now keeps it and ships the new defaults as mods.ini.default
Fixed: a crash or power cut while saving could wreck the old save; saves are written to a temporary file and swapped in only when complete ([fixes] safe_saves)
Fixed: a crash when quitting (the same translation fault sat at 29 places in the game)
Fixed: sound went silent for good after unplugging headphones or changing speakers ([fixes] audio_recover)
Fixed: memory overruns when every staff slot is full, with a very long save-file list, or with a broken sprite or head number ([fixes] bounds)
Fixed: the No Dandelion landmark checked the wrong spot when weeds grew, so it did not protect the tiles around it ([fixes] no_dandelion)

Fixed: robustness: clicks are never dropped under heavy input, text is never cut mid-character, art that fails to load retries, stricter mod setting numbers, and the installer refuses damaged discs instead of crashing
Fixed: the old 2002 menu and loading screen flashed at startup and after choosing a property (Build here). A clean loading card now covers every frame until the new screens are ready

releases.name: Playability fixes
releases.summary: Playability fixes: everything from the original game reachable in the new interface.
notes: Fixed: no way to create your pro or spend skill points in the new HUD. A new career now opens pro creation, People has a "Your pro" tab (Create pro, Profile, Skills, Practice, Match, Tournament), and accomplishments offer the three skill points again

Fixed: the pro profile at a career start was slow (about a second per click) and led to the tiny old skill screen. It is now "Create your pro" with clear steps, clicks register at once, and a new skill points page has big - and + buttons and a points counter

New: each accomplishment gets a clean page (trophy name, a photo of your course with its date, Continue to your 3 new skill points) instead of the half-screen wooden board; a crash when the trophy history was full is fixed
New: an HD golf-ball globe on the property map, in the new look
Fixed: backing out of the theme packs reset the theme; menus lay out text much faster
Fixed: the female head crash from the official 1.03 patch, ported
Fixed: dark see-through blobs at cliff corners with the HD art (rock chips drawn as shadows)
Fixed: a dark wedge behind waterfalls; golf's own waterfall spray is back
Fixed: an old popup frame showing beside the new Options menu
Fixed: a dark pixelated dot following the ball; the ball shadow is softer
Fixed: trees, palms and forests vanished at the farthest zoom
Fixed: the People tab had no golfer or staff list. Golfers now lists everyone with their mood and hole (click to jump to them), and Staff lists every employee with Hire, Fire, Move and Rename

Fixed: landmarks could not be placed, and benches, flower beds, scenic trees and bridges gave a random design. A chooser now shows a picture of every design, with Rotate (Tab); greens and the clubhouse get Rotate too
Fixed: building upgrades greyed out one level early; the N key (cancel match) was taken by the name tags toggle (name tags are now Shift+N)
New: cart path help (path view on Y, no-path markers), a tiny ball splash in water
Pro skills can grow past 100 percent on 18-hole courses

releases.name: Crash fix
releases.summary: Crash fix.
notes: Fixed: the game could crash a minute or two after loading a course, while drawing golfer portraits (also in 0.1.0 and 0.1.1)

releases.name: Fixes and small upgrades
releases.summary: Fixes and small upgrades.
notes: Fixed: with the HD art on, parts of the old 2002 HUD showed underneath the new course HUD
New HD start menu logo with Remastered built in ([ui] logo=original brings back the old one)
New golfer profile page (Profile button on the golfer card): edit the bio, see everything the golfer says; the year-end land purchase map in the new look
Smaller golf ball (about 25 percent), each golfer plays their own ball colour, smooth fading trail; Options, Gameplay has Ball size, Ball colours and Ball trail

releases.name: First public build
releases.summary: First public build.
notes: Native Windows program for the translated game: runs at any resolution, borderless full screen, smooth scrolling and zoom
Frosted Mint menus, dialogs, report panel and course HUD; Options page
Round HD golf ball, golfer names and speech bubbles
Optional HD art pack (separate download)
Mods: data tables for prices, personalities and difficulty
One-click installer that unpacks your own game files
